observations.behavior: Adds retention_days column and changes TTL to use retention_days instead of fixed 42 days.
observations.code_quote: ttl_clause = "" if settings.TEST else "TTL time_bucket + toIntervalDay(greatest(42, retention_days))"
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse logs to retain data longer than 42 days, potentially reducing churn and improving query performance.
